# Approval routing and approval origin

## What to build

Route approvals to the right person and show where they came from. Every run records an **origin** (`Run.origin`: what triggered it, from where, and who wrote it). Approval cards gain `waitingOn` (a specific member, or any member) and `trigger` (`{ kind, source, author, summary }`). A run a member started (their message, call, or task) can only be approved by that member; a run nobody in the space started (webhook, GitHub event or PR comment, schedule/routine, message routine, messaging channel, tickets, another bot) can be approved by any member, who sees the trigger text and its author on the card. Web and mobile approval cards render "waiting on" and the origin. Approval notifications for any-member runs go to every member.

## Decisions baked in

- `RunOrigin` (new, `packages/contracts/src/runs.ts`): `{ kind: "member" | "webhook" | "git_event" | "pr_comment" | "schedule" | "message_routine" | "messaging" | "bot" | "tickets" | "system", source?: string (≤200, e.g. "acme/api#42", "#deploys", routine name), author?: string (≤120, as the external system reported it, e.g. GitHub login, chat display name), summary?: string (≤280, plain text, trimmed; e.g. "workflow run failed on main" or the first 280 chars of the PR comment) }`.
- Requester-started (`waitingOn: { kind: "member", userId, name }`): `isOwnerStartedRun(trigger, followUpFromUser)` from `packages/core/src/action-approval.ts:185-188` is true (`user`, `call_end`, follow-up from user), or direct `messaging` from the member's own linked identity. Everything else is unattended (`waitingOn: { kind: "any" }`).
- Who may answer an approval ask in `commitAnswerRunInput`: `member` → only `run.userId` (already enforced for approval asks by the threads-sharing slice); `any` → any member of the space (thread access already implies membership). For unattended runs in a `kind: "team"` space, "always" and instruction-update approvals are also allowed for any member; in private spaces keep today's `run.userId` checks. Secret/credential/login asks stay run-owner only.
- Origin text is displayed as plain text only (no markdown/links rendered), truncated as above; never put it into the bot prompt beyond what is already there (GitHub deliveries deliberately exclude event-authored text from the prompt — keep that).
- The `approval.decided` audit event records the answering member as actor and `metadata.waitingOn` (`"member"` or `"any"`).

Already in the codebase: threads, messages and runs are shared across space members (queries by `spaceId`); `commitAnswerRunInput` (`packages/db/src/events.ts` ~795-1000) returns `null` for approval and secret asks unless `run.userId === answeredByUserId`; the client's `answerableAskIds` (`apps/web/src/pages/shell/transcript.tsx:533`) is false for another member's approval asks. `Space.kind` exists. `seedSharedSpaceFixture(prisma, { kind: "team" })` from `@rakazo/db` gives `{ spaceId, owner, member, outsider, cleanup }`.

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma` 873-936 (`Run`: `userId`, `trigger`, `routineId`, `sourceMessageId`), 1066-1090 (`ExternalEffect`).
- `packages/contracts/src/runs.ts` 10-28 (`RUN_TRIGGERS`), `packages/contracts/src/events.ts` 113-160 (ask block schema — add `waitingOn` and `trigger` optional fields there), 7-54 (event types).
- `packages/adapters/src/approval-ask.ts` 36-170 (`buildApprovalAskBlock(effectId, toolName, args, secrets, options)` — add options `waitingOn`, `trigger`).
- `packages/adapters/src/run-tool-gate.ts` 651-715 (`requestApproval` / `showApprovalCard`, `deps.events.pauseRunForInput(...)`, `notifyRun(deps, run, { kind: "help", title: "<bot> needs approval" })`).
- `packages/adapters/src/run-notifications.ts` ~54 (notifies `run.userId`) — for `any`, notify every space member (load `spaceMember` userIds) through the same path, respecting each member's own notification preference.
- `packages/db/src/events.ts` 1260-1350 (`pauseRunForInput`), 795-1000 (`commitAnswerRunInput`, approval branch quoted in the threads slice; "always" saves a rule ~975-985).
- Where runs are created (set `origin` there):
  - `packages/db/src/events.ts` 464-638 `sendUserMessage` (generic; accept an optional `origin` input and store it; default `{ kind: "member", author: <user name> }` when `trigger` is `user`).
  - `apps/api/src/webhook-inbound.ts` 261-330 `deliverWebhookEvent` (`trigger: "webhook"`, `userId: target.bot.userId`).
  - `apps/api/src/github-webhook.ts` 92-150 `githubDeliveryMetadata` and 218-231 (raw `payload`: `payload.sender.login`, `payload.comment.user.login`, `payload.comment.body`, `payload.repository.full_name`, PR/issue number, workflow run conclusion/branch) → `git_event` or `pr_comment` with `source` `owner/repo#n`, `author` login, `summary` (comment body excerpt, or "workflow run failed on <branch>"-style text built from the event name and action).
  - `apps/api/src/messaging-inbound.ts` 96-200 (direct, `trigger: "messaging"`), 678-735 (channel fan-out; sender in `channel_message` block `{ fromAddress, fromLabel }`), ~313-345 (`wakeMessageRoutines` → `message_routine`). Inbound fields: `packages/adapter-kit/src/types.ts` 882-915 (`from`, `fromLabel`, `channelName`).
  - `packages/adapters/src/run-routines.ts` 229-251 and ~420-437 (`schedule`, `source` routine name), `packages/adapters/src/routine-coalescing.ts` 48, `packages/adapters/src/ticket-wake.ts` 43 (`tickets`), `packages/adapters/src/bot-messages.ts` 261, `agent-connections.ts` 423, `job-reconciler.ts` 240, `apps/api/src/team-chat-bridge.ts` 963 (`bot`).
- Web: `apps/web/src/components/AskCard.tsx` (547 lines; `isApprovalAskBlock` at 113; card body 263-307; `formatAnsweredState` 28), `apps/web/src/pages/shell/message-view.tsx` 555-575 (renders `AskCard` with `canAnswer`), `apps/web/src/pages/shell/transcript.tsx` 533.
- Gallery: `apps/web/e2e/fixtures/gallery.tsx` 188-290 (`approvals` scenario with ask blocks) — add one unattended ask with `trigger` and `waitingOn: { kind: "any" }` and one with `waitingOn: { kind: "member", name: "Sam" }` rendered read-only; `apps/web/e2e/gallery.spec.ts` screenshots it.
- Mobile: `apps/mobile/components/thread/message-bubble.tsx` 346-428 (inline approval card), `apps/mobile/components/AskActions.tsx`; tests under `apps/mobile/lib` (pattern `apps/mobile/lib/ask-card.test.tsx`); every new `t("...")` string needs all 7 locales in `apps/mobile/lib/locales/*.ts` (gate `apps/mobile/lib/i18n.test.ts:205-219`).

## Patterns to follow

UI copy (keep exactly this minimal):
- Read-only card for someone else's run: `Waiting on {name}` in muted text under the title.
- Unattended card: one muted line under the title: `{summary}` then ` · {author}` and ` · {source}` when present (plain text). No extra labels or explanations.

## Step-by-step tasks

### CREATE `packages/db/prisma/migrations/20261111170000_run_origin/migration.sql`
- **IMPLEMENT**: `-- Additive: older releases never read this column.` `ALTER TABLE "runs" ADD COLUMN "origin" JSONB;` and `origin Json?` on `Run` in `schema.prisma`.

### UPDATE contracts (`runs.ts`, `events.ts`)
- **IMPLEMENT**: `RunOriginSchema`; ask block `waitingOn: z.discriminatedUnion("kind", [z.object({ kind: z.literal("member"), userId: Id, name: z.string() }), z.object({ kind: z.literal("any") })]).optional()`, `trigger: RunOriginSchema.optional()`.

### UPDATE run creation sites listed above to store `origin`.
### UPDATE `approval-ask.ts`, `run-tool-gate.ts`, `run-notifications.ts` to compute `waitingOn` + `trigger` from the run and notify accordingly.
### UPDATE `commitAnswerRunInput` and the answerable-ask computation for the `any` rule.
### UPDATE web `AskCard.tsx` / `message-view.tsx` and mobile `message-bubble.tsx` to render the two lines; `canAnswer` true for any member on `any` asks.
- **GOTCHA**: web strings via Lingui (`pnpm --filter @rakazo/web intl:extract`, fill all `messages.po`); mobile strings in all 7 locales.
- **VALIDATE**: `pnpm check --affected || pnpm check`

### TESTS
- `apps/api/src/approval-routing.postgres.test.ts` with `seedSharedSpaceFixture(prisma, { kind: "team" })`: (a) member-started run (trigger `user`, `userId = member`) pauses with an approval → ask block has `waitingOn.kind === "member"` and the member's id; owner's `threads.answer` → `CONFLICT`; member's → accepted, effect `approved`. (b) webhook run on the owner's bot (`deliverWebhookEvent` with a test payload) → `Run.origin.kind === "webhook"`, approval `waitingOn.kind === "any"`, member answers "allow" → accepted; "always" by member in the team space → accepted and a space rule saved. (c) GitHub PR comment delivery → `origin` `{ kind: "pr_comment", source: "<owner/repo>#<n>", author: <login>, summary: <comment excerpt ≤280> }`. (d) private space: unattended approval answered by the run owner still works; nobody else exists.
- Unit tests: `approval-ask` builds `waitingOn`/`trigger`; `AskCard` renders "Waiting on" read-only and the trigger line; mobile card test.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Requester-started approvals are actionable only by the requester; unattended ones by any member.
- [ ] Every approval card carries `waitingOn` and, for unattended runs, `trigger` with kind, source, author and summary.
- [ ] Web and mobile render both, as plain text.
- [ ] Any-member approvals notify every member; `approval.decided` audit records who answered.
- [ ] Private spaces unchanged.

## Validation commands

```bash
pnpm db:generate
pnpm check --affected || pnpm check
pnpm lint
pnpm exec vitest run packages/adapters/src apps/api/src apps/web/src/components
pnpm --filter @rakazo/mobile test
pnpm test:integration -- --spec=approval-routing
```

## Project rules that apply (from AGENTS.md)

- Public repo: no secrets, real emails or private URLs in code, tests or fixtures. Test emails use `@rakazo.test`.
- Use top-level `import type`, never inline type imports. Dynamic `import()` only for deferred loading.
- Migrations must work with the previous release running side by side: only add tables/columns (nullable or with a default). Never drop or rename in this task. Folder name `packages/db/prisma/migrations/YYYYMMDDHHMMSS_snake_name/migration.sql`; use a timestamp after `20261110120000` and unique to this task (the suffix in this task's text). First line is a comment such as `-- Additive: older releases never read or write these columns.`
- Every table with row-level security must be listed in `ROW_SECURITY_MODELS` (`packages/db/src/row-security.ts:96`), enforced by `packages/db/src/row-security.postgres.test.ts:789-799`. New tables follow `packages/db/prisma/migrations/20261109120000_audit_events/migration.sql:57-60` (ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY + a `_system` policy on `current_setting('app.rls_bypass', true) = 'on'`) and `20261022120000_row_level_security_tenant_tables` for tenant policies.
- Database access in tests and app code must run inside `runAsTenant` / `runAsSystem` (`packages/db/src/row-security.ts:27-40`); the vitest setup (`packages/testkit/src/pin-test-env.ts`) fails a suite that touches the database outside them.
- Tests are deterministic and offline. Postgres suites are `*.postgres.test.ts`, skipped unless `VERIFY_DATABASE=1` and `DATABASE_URL` are set (`describe.skipIf(!enabled).sequential(...)`, see `apps/api/src/board-rename.postgres.test.ts:10-13`).
- The API owns authorization and validation; frontends express intent and render state.
- Keep UI copy minimal: no explainer text that repeats the interface. Colors only via `@rakazo/ui-tokens` semantic tokens; reuse `packages/ui-web` components.
- Coordinate across instances through Postgres (transactions, advisory locks, claims), never in-process locks or in-memory counters.
- Do not run the desktop Playwright suite (`pnpm --filter @rakazo/desktop test:e2e`) locally.
